releases.name: Open 3D Viewer Studio 2026.44.17
changes: **OpenAEC Blueprint window:** title bar, ribbon (Home, View, Measure), a File page with recent files, explorer and properties panes, status bar, five themes, English and Dutch, and your own keyboard shortcuts.
**Revit and IFC in the desktop app:** .rvt, .rfa and .ifc open in the regular desktop app.
**Revit schedules:** a schedule opens as a table below the model; a row selects its elements.
**CityJSON, LandXML and DWG/DXF:** CityJSON and CityJSONSeq city models, LandXML TIN terrain and the polygon geometry from the model space of DWG and DXF files.
**Several models at once:** Open replaces the model, Add combines files, and every model has its own visibility toggle. IFC spaces start hidden in their own layer.
**Signed installers:** Windows (Authenticode), macOS (Developer ID, notarized by Apple) and Linux (OpenPGP), with SHA256SUMS and a GitHub build attestation for every file.
**One Rust code base:** the desktop app and the browser version (WebGPU) are built from the same code with iced and an own wgpu renderer.

releases.name: v0.1.0-alpha
changes: Custom NSIS template with file association page (Common 3D, CAD/BIM, Scene, Other)
Select All/Deselect All toggle, skips page in passive/update mode
Registry-based file associations with shell open command
Backend CLI arg handler emits open-file event to frontend on launch
EXE-only target (no MSI), custom installer icon
New "3D" logo on yellow-amber gradient (1024px master)
All platform icons: ICO, ICNS, PNG (32-310px), Windows Store logos
SVG favicon, MenuBar logo updated to match
i18next with browser language detection
English and Dutch locale files (11 namespaces each)
All UI strings extracted: ribbon, panels, menus, dialogs, status bar
Feedback dialog with category selector and email support
Axis indicator (XYZ gizmo) in viewport
Z-up coordinate system for cameras and controls
Walk mode scroll-wheel speed sync to store
Persistent user preferences via tauri-plugin-store
tauri 2 → 2.10.3, tauri-build 2 → 2.5.6
tauri-plugin-shell 2.3.5, dialog 2.6.0, fs 2.4.5, process 2.3.1
Added tauri-plugin-store 2.4.2, tokio time feature
Add Cargo.lock for reproducible builds
Updated .gitignore (temp/, .claude/, desktop.ini)
